weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入獅子座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往獅子座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，是時候踩剎車並採取更深思熟慮、溫和和戰略性的思維方式了，尤其是在與愛情和美學相關的領域。如果你準備好完全擁抱它，你會發現更深刻的性感。追求你想要的東西，但記得要小心並保持克制。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, it's time to hit the brakes and adopt a more thoughtful, gentle, and strategic mindset, particularly in areas related to love and aesthetics. You'll discover a deeper sense of sensuality if you're ready to embrace it fully. Pursue what you desire, but remember to do so with care and a sense of restraint.

taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you're reaching a pivotal moment in matters of love and aesthetics. Your creativity is soaring, and you might find yourself inspired to work on a grand artistic project. Remember, it takes discipline to channel that creative energy effectively. Don't allow fear to hold you back. Take the first step towards your aspirations, and the finer details will sort themselves out in due time.

Be mindful of the passing time; there's a purpose behind this push to address your responsibilities.

Remember to pace yourself as you move through the day.

You have the ability to blend these qualities seamlessly, so harness this energy to enhance your connections.
